Description of the measure: The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts to amend the list of variables set out in the Annex
The Commission is empowered to adopt implementing acts to specify the elements of the data to be transmitted, and their technical definitions and simplifications set in Article 5(4)
Actors to be involved (if applicable): Commission (Eurostat) European Statistical System Committee Member States
Expected timeline (if applicable): No deadline is defined. Adoption of the initial implementing act is expected shortly after the adoption of this Regulation.

Description of the measure: Launching pilot studies to be carried out by the Member States, on a voluntary basis
Commission role (if applicable): Identifying needs for significant new data requirements or improvements to the data covered by this Regulation

Description of the measure: The Commission is empowered to adopt implementing acts specifying the practical arrangements for the transmission of the data, for the content of, and deadlines for the transmission of the reference metadata and quality reports, as well as for the transmission of the inventories.
Actors to be involved (if applicable): Commission (Eurostat) European Statistical System Committee Member States
Expected timeline (if applicable): No deadline is defined. Adoption of the initial implementing act is expected shortly after the adoption of this Regulation.

Description of the measure: Financial contribution may be provided from the general budget of the Union for the development or enhancement of processes, software and similar support functions that aim to produce better quality statistics or to reduce the administrative and financial burden
Commission role (if applicable): Providing financing for the implementation of the Regulation
Actors to be involved (if applicable): The NSIs and other national authorities referred to in the list provided for in Article 5(2) of Regulation (EC) No 223/2009
